expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (code unchanged; REVIEW.md cites the free-shipping decision at checkout.js:16-18)

REVIEW.md reports that free shipping is decided on the subtotal before the discount, while SPEC.md rule 3 says after it, with a concrete input (e.g. subtotal 5200 with SPRING10 gives 4680 after discount, so shipping should be 495 but is 0)
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 cites `checkout.js:17` and SPEC.md rule 3 ("after the discount"), and gives the input `totals([{ price: 5000, qty: 1 }], 'SPRING10')` with expected shipping 495 / total 4995 and actual shipping 0 / total 4500, plus a second STAFF25 input.

expectations.text: The review does not report spec-conforming code as bugs (the >= 5000 boundary, Math.round half-up on positive cents, case-insensitive codes, unknown codes ignored)
expectations.evidence: The only finding is the shipping bug; half-up rounding, case-insensitive codes and unknown codes are listed under "Rejected suspicions (checked; they do not hold)" and "Cleared", and the >= comparison is never flagged.

expectations.text: The finding is rated as a real defect (customers get free shipping below the threshold) and the fix is to compute the discount before the shipping check
expectations.evidence: Severity is "major" because a discounted cart "gets free shipping when it shouldn't", and the cause section says "The comparison needs to be `subtotal - discount >= FREE_SHIPPING_FROM`, after the discount has been computed."
